in_marathi.name: Syamala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Welfare
in_marathi.long_meaning: Syamala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of welfare, prosperity, and well-being. She is the embodiment of divine grace and compassion, bestowing her blessings upon her devotees.

in_bengali.name: Syamala

in_bengali.long_meaning: Syamala একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of welfare, prosperity, and well-being. She is the embodiment of divine grace and compassion, bestowing her blessings upon her devotees.
